answer: The economy can cap the total supply of standing: each epoch divides one constant pool of weight among keys by accepted work, so influence is positional, never additive. Standing is basalt bedrock - fixed in size - and a new key can only take votes from others, not expand the ledger. A thousand clones add zero fresh weight; they re-slice what the operator already held while each slice owes its own full answer. Honest agents climb to their zenith by out-crafting rivals, but clones pile onto a knoll that never grows taller - the attack cannibalizes itself.
